description: Read-mostly capability catalog for the internal /fleet-help navigator.

generated_skills.summary: Step away while the fleet keeps supervising routine notifications and escalates only captain-relevant events.
sample_prompts: /afk
I am going afk for an hour.

generated_skills.summary: Recap visible session events since the prior real captain message and surface visibly unanswered captain decisions.
sample_prompts: /ahoy
What happened since my last message?

generated_skills.summary: Generate a standalone current-status report from bounded local fleet and registered-secondmate state.
sample_prompts: /bearings
Give me a morning status report.

generated_skills.summary: Explain what the fleet can do and recommend the next captain action from live read-only sources.
sample_prompts: /fleet-help what can the fleet do?
/fleet-help what should happen next?

generated_skills.summary: Sweep the session for uncaptured durable knowledge, route each finding to its disk home, and report reset safety.
sample_prompts: /stow
Stow what you learned before reset.

generated_skills.summary: Fast-forward firstmate and registered secondmates to the latest origin state, then refresh loaded instructions.
sample_prompts: /updatefirstmate
Update firstmate to the latest version.

lifecycle_operations.summary: Firstmate can turn an approved coding request into an isolated worker task that implements, validates, opens a PR, and waits for captain merge approval unless routine authority already applies.
sample_prompts: Fix the login redirect bug in pm-tools and ship a PR.
Build ONM-1234 with no-mistakes and stop at a PR for me to merge.

lifecycle_operations.display: Scout or investigate before changing code
lifecycle_operations.summary: Firstmate can commission a read-only or scratch investigation that produces a report before any implementation is authorized.
sample_prompts: Scout why the document list feels slow and report options.
Investigate this regression first; do not change code yet.

lifecycle_operations.summary: Firstmate can reproduce an end-user symptom, separate cause from masking conditions, and then either report findings or promote the scout into a fix when the captain authorizes implementation.
sample_prompts: Diagnose why fresh issues disappear from the project view.
Reproduce this browser error, find the cause, then ask before fixing.

lifecycle_operations.summary: Firstmate can run no-mistakes on a committed branch, coordinate review findings, tests, docs, lint, PR creation, and CI without adding a separate manual approval gate.
sample_prompts: Run no-mistakes on this branch and open the PR.
Review this plan for verification gaps only.

lifecycle_operations.display: Add, create, initialize, or remove projects
lifecycle_operations.summary: Firstmate can manage registered projects, delivery mode, project initialization, and outward-facing repository consent through the project-management contract.
sample_prompts: Add this repo to the fleet as direct-PR.
Create a private GitHub repo for this new project.

lifecycle_operations.display: Route a domain to a persistent second mate
lifecycle_operations.summary: Firstmate can create, sync, hand work to, recover, or retire a persistent second mate for a defined scope while the main home remains the captain's point of contact.
sample_prompts: Set up a second mate for pm-tools QA work.
Route this frontend maintenance stream to the existing second mate if it fits.

lifecycle_operations.summary: For projects that use Linear, firstmate can find or create the issue, post progress, link commits and PRs, and move the ticket at delivery milestones.
sample_prompts: Build ONM-1034 and keep the ticket updated.
Create Linear issues from this approved breakdown.

lifecycle_operations.summary: When a change ships, firstmate can include relevant README, architecture, runbook, or external-document updates through the project's doc discipline.
sample_prompts: Ship the fix and update the affected docs.
Sync the runbook after this deployment change.

lifecycle_operations.display: Answer eligible public mentions through X mode
lifecycle_operations.summary: When X mode is explicitly opted in, firstmate can classify eligible mentions, reply or dismiss, link spawned work, and post milestone follow-ups within the X-mode safety boundary.
mutates_when_requested_outside_help: fleet work only after eligible classification
sample_prompts: What can X mode safely handle?
Opt me out of X mode.
